name: catalyst_comprehensive_enzgfm_center_top1_v1
objective: Test whether the near-threshold EnzGFM+bounded-center R2E representation can become a material production upgrade when combined with the independently confirmed high-similarity Top-2000 pair residual under an explicit coarse-rank1 protection rule.

development_split.split_type: strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint deterministic salted hash double-cold

confirmation_split.split_type: strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint deterministic salted hash double-cold

matched_baseline.role: fresh reconstruction of the current production R2E model family on the frozen split

candidate_coarse.prior_evidence_boundary: The previous comprehensive_directional_center_v1 family was rejected because its pooled gain narrowly missed the preregistered material threshold; its revealed folds are not reused here.

top2000_refinement.decision: if max_train_drfp_tanimoto < 0.9, preserve the exact candidate-coarse ranking; otherwise preserve the exact candidate-coarse rank1 candidate and rerank only the remaining Top-2000 shortlist positions using pair residual scale 0.03

overall_required_vs_current_mainline: pooled MRR candidate route >= matched baseline
pooled MAP candidate route >= matched baseline
pooled NDCG@10 candidate route >= matched baseline
pooled Hit@10 candidate route >= matched baseline
pooled Hit@20 candidate route >= matched baseline
pooled Hit@50 candidate route >= matched baseline
low_reaction_similarity_lt0p3_required_v: pooled MRR candidate route >= matched baseline
pooled MAP candidate route >= matched baseline
pooled Hit@10 candidate route >= matched baseline - 0.005
median best-positive rank candidate route <= matched baseline
router_invariants: every query with max_train_drfp_tanimoto < 0.9 has exact candidate-coarse positive ranks
every selected query with max_train_drfp_tanimoto >= 0.9 preserves the exact candidate-coarse rank1 candidate
rank1 protection is input/rank based and never uses target labels
development_gate.fold_stability: Candidate-route MRR and MAP may not regress by more than 0.005 versus matched baseline on any development fold, and at least one of MRR/MAP must improve on at least 2/3 folds.
development_gate.material_gain: At least one pooled overall metric must reach +0.01 absolute MRR, +0.01 absolute MAP, or +2.0 percentage points Hit@10 versus the matched current-mainline baseline.
development_gate.if_fail: Reject this family. Do not change protected prefix, pair scale, similarity threshold, shortlist size, center cap, salt, folds, or use revealed/external metrics to rescue it.
development_gate.if_pass: Run only the pre-frozen confirmation split once with exactly the same recipes and routing semantics.

confirmation_gate.low_reaction_similarity_lt0p3: MRR and MAP may not regress versus matched baseline; Hit@10 may not regress by more than 0.005.
confirmation_gate.if_pass: Promote the candidate R2E route and then rerun production/open-world retention checks without selecting on their revealed labels.
